notes: Added stories for schema contracts, core routing logic hardening, API exposure, tests, and integration.

change_log.value: Add tool schema registry and contract enforcement
Expose tool routing via API boundary
Comprehensive unit and edge case tests

stories.title: Tool Schema Registry and Contract Enforcement
stories.description: Create a centralized registry mapping tool names to Pydantic schemas and enforce strict validation contracts before dispatch, ensuring consistency across all tool models.

stories.title: Core Tool Routing Decision Logic Hardening
stories.description: Enhance routing logic to deterministically select tools based on allowlist membership and tool_use blocks, including fallback handling when multiple or ambiguous tool calls are present.

stories.title: Tool Router API Boundary Integration
stories.description: Integrate the tool router with the FastAPI entrypoint to ensure validated tool calls flow cleanly between the agent loop and backend services, including standardized request/response structures.

stories.title: Tool Router Unit and Edge Case Test Coverage
stories.description: Expand unit tests to cover allowlist enforcement, schema validation failures, malformed tool_use blocks, and multi-tool scenarios.

stories.title: End-to-End Tool Routing Integration with Agent Loop
stories.description: Validate full integration of tool routing within the Claude agentic loop, ensuring tool selection, validation, execution, and response propagation function correctly across real conversation flows.
